jobPostingInfo.title: Legal Associate
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Brookfield is seeking a Legal Associate reporting to the Managing Director, Legal & Regulatory.

  • Support corporate governance, board of directors materials and regulatory compliance
  • Draft and negotiate commercial agreements and joint venture documents; support M&A due diligence
  • Manage external counsel and coordinate cross-border matters
  • Assist with risk management and policy development

Qualifications: Member in good standing of the Law Society of Ontario; 2-4 years of experience at a leading law firm or in-house.
